One of the best Part-2 ResuHub tales thus far. I like the mix of action, backstory, and character development.

It's really what I like about this Canon, that sentient skips aren't just containment procedures, but individuals.

Medicating Iris might nullify her abilities or screw with them in ways we don't understand. But the Foundation stole most of that girl's childhood. You don't come out of that normal."

I've read all of Resu hub thus far and this is the first I've seen this paid any time.

+1 so hard.

Cimmerian opened his mouth to speak, paused, and then continued. "Ok. That's a fingertip vibrator."

"It is."

Cimmerian blinked. "Why do you have that?"

"Last week was my birthday."

Well uh. Alright then. I'm not curious as to why, but as to who got Clef that for his birthday…

item.content:encoded:
This scratches an itch I thought I was going to have to scratch myself1. Sure, the Foundation has a number of sapient skips that have potential to be useful in the field, but would they be reliable? Would they fold under pressure? Run when given the chance? Would they be able to work effectively as part of a team? An Alpha-9 candidate should ideally meet the same physical, intellectual and psychological standards of a regular agent, and have an anomalous ability with clear field utility under conscious control. I suspect that the bigwigs behind Alpha-9 are going to figure this out the hard way.

Footnotes
1. but I figured a strongly-worded memo about candidate selection criteria would make for the most boring tale ever. It would at least have contained a brief cameo by Cactusman…
